vision.name: Bojack
vision.text:
(You cannot win by MPPV if you advance a level with this card's effect.)
[Instant] POWER: Use when entering combat. Banish "Team Bojack" you own in play to advance your MP 1 level.
POWER: [Attack] Energy attack costing 2 stages.
Lower your opponent's anger 2 levels.
DAMAGE: 5 life cards.
HIT: Search your Banished Zone for a Named card and Rejuvenate it.
